product_metadata.title: WINLIFE 100% Cotton Quilted Pillow Sham Floral Printed Pillow Cover King Size (Khaki)
features: Material: 100% cotton. Both the front and back are woven with cotton fabric, and the middle layer is made of high-quality absorbent cotton. Skin-friendly and safe, WINLIFE protects your healthy sleep.
EXQUISITE WORKMANSHIP: Fine Stitching with smooth and neat sealing, strong and firm, which effectively avoid unraveling to prolong the use of time.

Simply classic - Solid color compliments existing bedding decor. Embroidered design adds a stylish accent to your bedroom decoration. Neutral color fit any bedroom theme. If you want the matching quilt set, please search B07F8SHLPZ
Easy to care - Machine washable in cold, gentle cycle, tumble dry low heat, durable quality
